outcome: Document review reads and records its decision through the live document-review API
acceptance_criteria: The page reads the live preview by integer id and shows title, `v{version}`, audience and each `preview[]` item as a numbered section — verify: on the mock, open `/projects/P-0101/documents/2901`; the page shows "Statement of work · v2", the audience, and sections "Scope" and "Fees" with text as plain characters (a `<b>` in a fixture section shows literally); `tests/document-review.test.tsx` asserts the request path `/api/v1/projects/<case>/document-reviews/2901`.

An invalid id (`abc`, `0`, `2.5`, `02`, 20 digits) sends no request and shows "You can't open this document" — verify: `tests/document-review.test.tsx` asserts no fetch; `/projects/P-0101/documents/abc` in the browser.

403 and 404 look identical and reveal nothing — verify: live as `live-none`, open a document URL of `live-lead`'s project (real case UUID and version id from the live Documents tab or database); and the mock no-access id; both show the same text with no title or id.

Controls follow `decisions[]` only — verify: with `["approve","return"]` both buttons show; with `["return"]` only Return; with `[]` no controls and "No decision is open to you on this version."; a test with `["approve","return","reject"]` shows no Reject button.

Approve sends exactly `{expected_revision, verdict:"approve", delegated:false, note}` to `POST .../document-reviews/{id}` and nothing is sent to `/tasks/*`, `/work/*` or any claim endpoint — verify: `tests/document-review.test.tsx` captures the body (all four keys, `delegated === false`, `expected_revision` equals the GET `revision`) and asserts no other POST.

The note is required for Approve and Return; checked before any request — verify: pressing Approve with an empty or blank note shows "Add a note to record your decision." beside the note field, focuses it and sends nothing; a 4001-character note shows the 4000 message and sends nothing (`tests/document-review-model.test.ts` for `noteProblem`, `tests/document-review.test.tsx` for the page). On a phone width (390) Approve opens the same note sheet as Return (see Conflicts).

After a 200, the page re-reads and shows the live result — verify: mock decidable then approve; a toast "You approved v2. Not sent to the client." shows, the next GET returns empty `decisions[]`, and the controls are gone and the status tag shows the new `review_status`. Return does the same with "You returned v2."

409 stale keeps the note and records nothing — verify: mock scenario with a stale `revision`; the callout "This document changed while you were reading it..." shows, the page now carries the new revision, the note box still holds the typed text, and a second press sends the new `expected_revision`.

422 `action_unavailable` shows its message and refreshes the controls — verify: mock blocked-after-load scenario; message shows, controls follow the new `decisions[]`, and `findings[]` sentences list under "Not ready to decide yet". A 422 with a `note` field error shows on the note field.

403 on the write and an expired-CSRF write record nothing and say so — verify: mock 403 and `csrf_failed` scenarios in `tests/document-review.test.tsx`; the 403 shows "You can't record a decision on this document."
A network or 5xx failure on the write shows the uncertain notice, keeps the buttons off, and Try again only re-reads — verify: test counts POSTs (exactly one) and GETs after pressing Try again.
Double press sends one write — verify: test presses Approve twice quickly; one POST.
A failed publication read does not break the page — verify: test with `.../publication` answering 500; the document, sections and controls still show, without a status tag.

Dropped parts are gone and nothing replaces them — verify: `tests/document-review.test.tsx` asserts no TEST TEMPLATE text, no "changed since", no Compare control, no per-check Done/Held/Blocked list, no returned person/time/note, and no reference in the crumb; `matchingSources` (from `frontend/tests/source-files.ts`) finds no use of `django_url` in `src/features/documents`.

Crumb is the project title and "Documents" only, no reference — verify: mock page at 1440 and 390; the phone back link reads the project title with no reference note. If the project read fails the crumb is "Documents" alone and the page still works.
`current: false` shows "Not the current version" and `review_status` text shows in the status tag as sent, unquoted and unparsed — verify: mock not-current and returned scenarios.

A Documents-tab row links to review only when its `api_url` is exactly `/api/v1/projects/{this case}/document-reviews/{n}`; any other row is plain text, with a test for a row whose `api_url` names another case, another path, `//host/...` or null — verify: `tests/project-tabs.test.tsx` (or a new `tests/documents-link.test.ts`); live Documents tab run recorded in `build.md`.

The mock bodies validate against the live contract and a deliberately wrong fixture fails — verify: `npx vitest run tests/mock-live-document-review.test.ts` passes; adding a forbidden field to one fixture makes it fail.

Live end to end (integration owner) — verify: against Django 8010, as `live-lead` open a real document version URL, read it, and record one Return with a note; the next GET changes `decisions[]`/`review_status` and the database or API shows one new review; `live-none` gets the no-access state; record the commands and results in `build.md`. If no seeded document version exists in the live database, record that and mark this criterion held for a seeded fixture (backend), without faking data.
The E2E flow still passes on the mock — verify: `e2e/document-review.spec.ts` (rewritten) at 1440 and 390 covers read, return with note, approve with note, stale and no-access.

risk.rationale: Medium. It is a cross-layer contract change from v7 `/tasks/{id}/decision` to the live document-review contract (integer version id, required `delegated`, `reject` verdict in the API), and the write records a review decision that affects the document's publication state. It is not high: no money, identity or migration, one write call, and `expected_revision` guards against races. Surfaces are ui and api, plus contract-change and product-decision, because the dropped parts, the note rule and the `delegated` default are choices the client must accept.
